findAnswersClauseverify: Find answers to common questions about clauseverify
faqA1_1: clauseverify is a mobile application that uses AI-powered technology to analyse legal contracts and documents, helping users understand risky, unusual, or potentially problematic clauses before they sign.
faqQ1_2: How do I create an account?
faqA1_2: Tap "Sign Up" on the login screen. Enter your email, create a password, and verify your email address via the link sent to your inbox.
faqA1_3: You can download and register for free. Certain advanced features, like detailed analysis reports or unlimited scans, may require a Premium subscription. Check the "Premium" section in the app for details.
faqQ2_1: How does the analysis process work?
faqA2_1:
• Upload a PDF/DOC file, or take clear photos of your contract using the in-app camera.
• Our AI reads the full document and analyses every clause for risks.
• You receive an instant risk score and a detailed report explaining each clause in plain language.
faqQ2_2: What should I upload for the best result?
faqA2_2:
For best results, provide a clear, complete copy of your contract:
• All pages of the document, in order
• Sharp, well-lit, non-blurry text
• The full agreement rather than partial excerpts
faqQ2_3: How accurate is the AI analysis?
faqA2_3: Our AI is trained on extensive legal text datasets and provides a high-confidence analysis. Important: The result is an assistive, informational tool — not legal advice and not a substitute for a qualified lawyer. For high-stakes contracts, we recommend consulting a licensed attorney.
faqQ2_4: The AI can't read my document properly. What should I do?
faqA2_4: Ensure your scan or photos are clear, well-lit, and not blurry, and that all pages are included. If the problem persists, try re-uploading in a different format (PDF instead of images, or vice versa).
faqQ3_1: How do I reset my password?
faqA3_1: On the login screen, tap "Forgot Password." Enter your email to receive a reset link.
faqQ3_2: How do I upgrade to Premium?
faqA3_2: Go to your Profile → "Upgrade to Premium" or "Subscription." Select your plan and follow the payment instructions.
faqQ3_3: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqA3_3: Subscriptions are managed through your device's store (Google Play Store or Apple App Store). Go to your store account settings → Subscriptions to cancel.
faqQ3_4: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
faqA3_4: All your personal data and scan history will be permanently deleted from our servers. This action cannot be undone.
faqQ4_1: The app crashes or freezes. What can I do?
faqA4_1:
• Ensure you have the latest version of the app installed.
• Restart the app and your phone.
• Check your internet connection.
faqQ4_2: I'm having trouble uploading or scanning my document.
faqA4_2:
• Grant the necessary camera and file-access permissions in your phone settings.
• Clean your phone's camera lens if photographing pages.
• Avoid scanning in dark or reflective environments.
faqQ5_1: Is my data and document library secure?
faqA5_1: Yes. We take privacy seriously. Your documents and data are encrypted and processed securely. We do not share your personal data with third parties without disclosing it to you first. For details, please read our Privacy Policy.
faqA5_2: No. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information or your uploaded contracts. Data is used solely to provide and improve the analysis service.
privacyPolicyIntro: clauseverify respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how your information is collected, used, and protected when you use the clauseverify application and services.
privacyContent1_1: We may collect the following information:
privacyContent1_2:
a) User Information
• Email address (for account creation and access)
• Subscription status (Free or Premium)
privacyContent1_3:
b) Uploaded Content
• Contract documents, PDFs, or images of documents that you upload for AI analysis
• Optional metadata related to the document (document type, jurisdiction, if provided)
privacyContent1_4:
c) Usage Data
• Number of analyses performed
• Dates and times of usage
• Application interactions (for performance and abuse prevention)
privacyContent1_5:
d) Payment Information
• Payments are processed securely via third-party providers (e.g., Stripe)
• clauseverify does not store credit card details
privacyContent2_1:
Your information is used strictly to:
• Provide AI-based analysis of the contracts and documents you upload
• Generate AI Contract Analysis Reports
• Manage user accounts and subscriptions
• Monitor usage limits and prevent abuse
• Improve application performance and reliability
• Ensure platform security and cost control
privacyContent3_1:
• Uploaded documents (PDFs, images) are sent to our AI service provider for processing and may be temporarily stored to generate your analysis
• AI Analysis Reports may be generated once and are not guaranteed to be permanently stored
• Minimal metadata (report ID, risk scores, date) may be retained for verification and security purposes
• Data is retained only as long as necessary to provide the service
privacyContent4_1: We do not sell or rent your personal data or your uploaded contracts.
privacyContent4_2:
To analyse your contract, the text and/or images of the document you upload are sent to Anthropic's Claude AI, our third-party AI service provider, solely for the purpose of generating your clause-by-clause analysis. Data may also be shared with:
• Trusted hosting and cloud infrastructure providers
• Payment processors (for subscription billing, e.g. Stripe)
• Legal authorities, if required by law

Your contract content is not used by Anthropic's Claude AI to train their models, and all third parties are contractually required to comply with data protection standards equivalent to ours. By submitting a document for analysis, you consent to it being shared with Anthropic's Claude AI for this purpose; you will be asked to confirm this consent before each upload.
privacyContent5_1:
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including:
• Secure, encrypted API communication with our AI provider
• Encrypted data transmission
• Access controls and monitoring
• Abuse detection and usage limits

However, no system can be 100% secure.
privacyContent6_1:
By using clauseverify, you agree:
• To upload only documents you have the right to share and to redact any information you do not wish to disclose
• Not to misuse the platform or attempt to bypass usage limits
• To accept that AI-based results are informational only and are not legal advice
